channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: Iran’s IRGC downs US drone over Hormuz as efforts to end war remain stalled
item.description: Iran reiterates conditions for Hormuz reopening as US slaps sanctions on four Iranians it says acted as 'oil trustees'.

item.title: Swimmer braves tanker attacks to expose Hormuz contamination
item.description: As tankers burned in Hormuz, swimmer Lewis Pugh exposed another casualty of the US-Israeli war on Iran: marine life.

item.title: At least four killed, 35 injured in fire at power station in Iraq’s Basra
item.description: The blaze erupted at the Hartha power station and spread to nearby houses.

item.title: Emergency crews in Ukraine hit by a double-tap strike
item.description: Video shows emergency crews in Ukraine approaching the scene of a Russian strike, before another strike hits.

item.title: Netanyahu is playing with the fire that killed Rabin
item.description: His attacks on Arab lawmakers echo the incitement that preceded Rabin’s assassination and risk unleashing new violence.

item.title: Saudi-led coalition intercepts three Houthi missiles headed for Riyadh
item.description: Saudi Arabia issues emergency alerts in Riyadh for third night in row, as the Houthis threaten ports and power station.

item.title: Man convicted of starting Palisades fire in Los Angeles
item.description: The 30-year-old LA resident was convicted of arson leading to wildfires that killed 12 people and destroyed more than 6,800 buildings.

item.title: Nearly 600 women killed in South Africa within three months
item.description: Police officials called for "greater efforts to prevent... violence" against women and children.

item.title: US declassifies more UFO footage filmed in the Middle East
item.description: The Pentagon has released an eighth tranche of UFO records, which includes three video clips recorded in 2020, 2023 and 2026.

item.title: 'I tell my son it's just fireworks': Life inside Yemeni city besieged by Houthis
item.description: Orla Guerin speaks to seven people trapped in the key city of Taiz, cut off from the outside world for weeks.
